title: EasyDeploy AI
tagline: AI-Powered Token Factory: From Text to DEX in One Click powered by ENS
description:
EasyDeployAI revolutionizes token creation by combining AI, ENS, and DeFi integrations into a seamless launch platform. Users simply describe their token in natural language, and our platform leverages Google's Gemini AI to generate optimized token specifications, automatically creates branded ENS subdomains (tokenname.easydeployai.eth), and integrates with DEXs for immediate trading capability.

What sets EasyDeployAI apart:

🤖 Natural Language Token Creation: Users describe their token idea, and Gemini AI handles the technical details
 Automatic ENS Integration: Every token gets its own .easydeployai.eth subdomain
 Dynamic Logo Generation: AI-generated SVG logos based on token symbols
 Instant Trading: Deep 1inch integration for immediate liquidity
 Decentralized Storage: IPFS-based metadata and logo storage via NFT.Storage
how_its_made:
EasyDeployAI is built with a modern web3 stack that emphasizes scalability, security, and user experience:

Smart Contracts (Solidity + OpenZeppelin)

Minimal, gas-optimized ERC20 implementation
Factory pattern for predictable token deployment
OpenZeppelin's battle-tested contract primitives
Deployed on Sepolia for accessibility

Backend (Node.js + Express)

AI Integration:

Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash model for token specification generation
Custom prompt engineering for consistent JSON output
Automated validation and sanitization layer
ENS Integration:

Complex ownership validation using eth-ens-namehash
Multi-step secure subdomain registration process
Fallback resolver configuration for maximum compatibility

Frontend (Next.js 14 + Tailwind)

RainbowKit for seamless wallet connection
Wagmi hooks for blockchain interactions
Ethers.js v6 for modern contract interactions
Responsive Tailwind design system
Storage & Infrastructure

NFT.Storage for decentralized logo and metadata storage
IPFS for permanent, decentralized access
SVG-based logo generation for infinite scaling

Price Fetching:
Pyth Price Feed on Sepolia (Eth Testnet) to show the token's real time value

We leveraged several ETHGlobal sponsor technologies:

ENS: Deep integration for automatic subdomain creation and management
Pyth: Price feeds to show price of the token the user just deployed
